stories.title: Houthis claim large-scale missile and drone attack on Saudi air base
stories.summary: Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis claimed a large-scale missile and drone attack on King Khalid Air Base in southern Saudi Arabia, a sharp escalation in the conflict. Riyadh had not immediately confirmed the strike.

stories.title: Protests break out across Syria over fuel price increases
stories.summary: Protesters in several Syrian cities, including along the highway between Aleppo and Turkey, demonstrated after the government raised diesel prices by up to 40% and gasoline by 28%. The hikes, tied to an overhaul of the Baniyas refinery, drew some of the sharpest unrest in years.

stories.title: Rescuers search for ~130 people still missing after Indonesian ferry sinks
stories.summary: The Indonesian ferry Virgo Transport 8 sank in the Java Sea en route from Surabaya to Banjarmasin, with crews searching for roughly 129 people still unaccounted for after 108 of the 243 on board were rescued. At least six people died in the incident.

stories.title: New warnings about the risks of AI to humanity revive a long-running debate
stories.summary: Fresh warnings from the AI industry, including Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call to slow model development, have revived debate over whether advanced models could escape human control and threaten humanity. The push comes as OpenAI and Anthropic weigh potential IPOs.

stories.title: Samsung and SK Hynix refuse KEPCO's $18.7B power prepayment ask
stories.summary: Samsung and SK Hynix rebuffed a request to prepay roughly $18.7 billion in electricity bills meant to help fund grid investments feeding their chip mega-clusters, citing uncertainty over the long-term chip cycle. The refusal leaves state utility KEPCO scrambling for alternate financing to support AI-chip capacity expansion.

stories.title: Browns' Week 1 failures aplenty in 34-10 loss to Jaguars
stories.summary: Cleveland's season-opening 34-10 loss to Jacksonville exposed issues across the offense and secondary, drawing sharp grades from analysts. Head coach Todd Monken said it would be 'unfair' to pin the defeat entirely on any one player or unit.

stories.title: Browns QB Deshaun Watson sounds off on critics after loss to Jaguars
stories.summary: Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson hit back at critics after the 34-10 season-opening loss to the Jaguars, defending his performance despite widespread scrutiny over the defeat. The loss dropped Cleveland to 0-1 under new head coach Todd Monken.

stories.title: Kimi Antonelli wins Formula 1 race in Madrid to extend championship lead
stories.summary: Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli won the Spanish Grand Prix at the new Madring street circuit, beating Max Verstappen and Lando Norris after a virtual safety car undid pole-sitter Norris' control of the race. The win strengthened Antonelli's lead in the drivers' title fight.

stories.title: Kimi Antonelli wins Spanish Grand Prix in F1's return to Madrid
stories.summary: Formula 1 returned to Madrid for the first time in 45 years as Kimi Antonelli won the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix and hoisted the churro-shaped trophy. The result added to Mercedes' strong run as the season's championship picture tightens.

stories.title: One dead after fiery wrong-way crash closes I-71 in downtown Columbus
stories.summary: One person died after a fiery, wrong-way, four-vehicle collision shut down I-71 north in downtown Columbus. At least one other person was hospitalized and police were investigating.

stories.title: Gahanna sees multiple acts of vandalism against Flock cameras amid controversy
stories.summary: Gahanna was the target of multiple acts of vandalism against Flock license-plate cameras, part of a string of similar incidents across central Ohio. The cameras, used by police to track suspects and missing people, have drawn national privacy scrutiny this year.

stories.title: Columbus police release video of person of interest near home where couple was killed
stories.summary: Columbus police released video of a person of interest spotted near the home where a couple was killed, asking the public for help identifying them. The footage is central to the ongoing homicide investigation.
